description: Lodha Mirabelle is an apartment development in the Manyata Business Park setting, marketed around an approximately 19-acre residential ecosystem. Developer material presents three-bedroom homes with a study and four-bedroom formats, making the additional living space an important part of its positioning.

content.faqsTitle: Six things to know about Lodha Mirabelle

faqs.question: Where exactly is Lodha Mirabelle located?
faqs.answer: Manyata Business Park residential enclave, off Outer Ring Road, Nagavara, Bengaluru, Karnataka, 560045. The Google Maps link uses this project and address.

faqs.question: What configurations and sizes are documented?
faqs.answer: The current developer site shows 3-bedroom-with-study and 4-bedroom plans. The selected Phase 1 CP price table gives carpet ranges of 1,450–1,550 and 1,850–1,950 sq ft respectively. Confirm the exact offered unit because developer plans, saleable areas and later phases differ.

faqs.question: What is the published starting price?
faqs.answer: ₹2.99 Cr–₹3.49 Cr* Onward. The pricing record identifies the source and quoted configuration. Unpriced formats are excluded from the reference range; a current cost sheet is needed for the selected unit. Applicable charges are itemised separately by the source.

faqs.question: What is the status and possession timeline?
faqs.answer: Under construction. Published timeline: Developer campaign reference by 2028; CP Phase 1 December 2026 — verify selected phase. The date differs by phase and must be matched to the offered home.

faqs.question: What are the main amenities?
faqs.answer: Swimming Pool, Club House, Kids Play Area, Multi Purpose Court, Senior Citizen Area, Kids Pool. 35+ developer-marketed indoor and outdoor amenities. These are published facilities; confirm which are completed and accessible to your selected phase.

faqs.question: What makes this project worth comparing?
faqs.answer: Approximately 19 acre marketed ecosystem Manyata Business Park setting Three bedroom with study and four bedroom formats. Aaramv can compare these features with your space needs, budget and daily routes, and help coordinate the next steps through move-in.
